title: GTO: The Early Years - Shonan Junai Gumi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The prequel to Great Teacher Onizuka follows teenage Eikichi Onizuka and his best friend Ryuji Danma, leaders of the biker gang Oni-Baku in Shonan. Between gang wars and street fights, the pair chase girls with little success, and their humor and leadership end up uniting rival gangs. Over-the-top fighting is mixed with slapstick and one-shot comedy chapters.
life_message: Loyalty to friends, protecting the weak and keeping your own code matter more than rules, even for delinquents.
